title: BackToClassics
description: This mod brings back Classic blocks to modern minecraft.
body:
# Welcome to the Back to Classics mod!
## What does this mod introduce?
This mod adds back classic and iconic blocks and items like
Classic grass blocks, Classic bricks, and more!
# Q&A
## Is this mod gonna be finished yet?
Not yet, It's still in a beta and is just a mod made by one person.
So don't expect this mod to be finished.
## Can you port this mod to forge?
Not yet, But i'll try porting it soon.
# Enjoy the mod!
# Also get the mod in curseforge:
[Curseforge link](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/backtoclassics)
